nodes.label: React Best Practices (Vercel Engineering guide)
nodes.rationale: Optimized for AI agents/LLMs maintaining or generating React/Next.js code; rules prioritized by impact

nodes.label: Eliminating Waterfalls
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL: each sequential await adds full network latency; #1 performance killer

nodes.label: Bundle Size Optimization
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL: reducing initial bundle improves TTI and LCP

nodes.label: Server-Side Performance
nodes.rationale: HIGH: eliminates server-side waterfalls and reduces response times

nodes.label: Client-Side Data Fetching
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM-HIGH: deduplication reduces redundant network requests

nodes.label: Re-render Optimization
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM: fewer re-renders minimize wasted computation

nodes.label: Rendering Performance
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM: reduces browser rendering work

nodes.label: JavaScript Performance
nodes.rationale: LOW-MEDIUM: hot-path micro-optimizations add up

nodes.label: Advanced Patterns
nodes.rationale: LOW: specific cases requiring careful implementation

nodes.label: 1.1 Check Cheap Conditions Before Async Flags
nodes.rationale: Avoid paying for async flag fetch when a cheap synchronous guard already fails

nodes.label: 1.2 Defer Await Until Needed
nodes.rationale: Move await into branches that use it to avoid blocking unused paths

nodes.label: 1.3 Dependency-Based Parallelization
nodes.rationale: Start each task at earliest possible moment for partial dependencies (2-10x)

nodes.label: 1.4 Prevent Waterfall Chains in API Routes
1.6 Strategic Suspense Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Trade-off: faster initial paint vs potential layout shift

nodes.label: 2.1 Avoid Barrel File Imports
nodes.rationale: Barrel files can load thousands of modules (200-800ms import cost); tree-shaking fails for externals

nodes.label: 2.3 Defer Non-Critical Third-Party Libraries
nodes.rationale: Analytics/logging do not block interaction; load after hydration

nodes.label: 2.5 Prefer Statically Analyzable Paths
nodes.rationale: Dynamic paths widen bundles and output file tracing, slowing builds and cold starts

nodes.label: 3.1 Authenticate Server Actions Like API Routes
nodes.rationale: Server Actions are public endpoints and can be invoked directly, bypassing middleware

nodes.label: 3.2 Avoid Duplicate Serialization in RSC Props
nodes.rationale: RSC serialization dedupes by reference, not value

nodes.label: 3.3 Avoid Shared Module State for Request Data
nodes.rationale: Concurrent server renders share module scope; causes cross-request leaks

nodes.label: 3.4 Cross-Request LRU Caching
nodes.rationale: React.cache only works per request; LRU spans sequential requests

nodes.label: 3.5 Hoist Static I/O to Module Level
nodes.rationale: Module-level code runs once on import, not per request

nodes.label: 3.7 Parallel Data Fetching with Component Composition
3.9 Per-Request Deduplication with React.cache()
nodes.rationale: React.cache uses Object.is shallow equality; inline objects always miss

nodes.label: 4.2 Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling Performance
4.4 Version and Minimize localStorage Data
nodes.rationale: Versioned keys enable schema evolution; storing minimal fields avoids PII/tokens

nodes.label: 5.2 Defer State Reads to Usage Point
5.3 Do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in useMemo
nodes.rationale: useMemo overhead can exceed the cost of the expression

nodes.label: 5.4 Don't Define Components Inside Components
nodes.rationale: New component type each render forces full remount

nodes.label: 5.5 Extract Default Non-primitive Parameter Value from Memoized Component to Constant
5.8 Put Interaction Logic in Event Handlers
5.11 Use Functional setState Updates
nodes.rationale: Prevents stale closures and gives stable callback references

nodes.label: 5.14 Use useDeferredValue for Expensive Derived Renders
6.1 Animate SVG Wrapper Instead of SVG Element
nodes.rationale: Browsers lack hardware acceleration for SVG element animation

nodes.label: 6.5 Prevent Hydration Mismatch Without Flickering
nodes.rationale: Synchronous inline script updates DOM before hydration

nodes.label: 6.8 Use defer or async on Script Tags
6.11 Use useTransition Over Manual Loading States
7.2 Build Index Maps for Repeated Lookups
7.8 Early Length Check for Array Comparisons
7.11 Use flatMap to Map and Filter in One Pass
7.12 Use Loop for Min/Max Instead of Sort
7.14 Use toSorted() Instead of sort() for Immutability
nodes.rationale: sort() mutates props/state, breaking React immutability model
